scope: Completed annotation target editing, service-managed capture state and source lifecycle
result: executor verification passed; independent retest pending

sourceStates.bound: A complete service-confirmed scene source, presentation, target and annotation version.
sourceStates.awaiting: The saved current target and version await a newly held Done scene; no source or snapshot placeholder is stored.

transitions: Ordinary target edit validates the canonical prior capture state, advances the version, saves the new target and clears its current capture/source in one transaction.
Done holds a new displayed scene and changes awaiting to bound at the same saved target version.
Comment-only edits keep their bound source, capture and version.
Explicit recapture changes a bound source and advances the version.
Changing a persisted pending target back advances another version and keeps the evidence incomplete.
A source previously bound to another version of the same annotation cannot stand in for the new Done proof.
Unresolved deleted object targets fail atomically while the previous saved target remains available.
Prior bound source and committed capture records remain readable as historical evidence.
clientRule: Ordinary and captured saves serialize captureState/capture from the latest canonical server annotation; local incomplete display state expresses the user's changed target.
migration: A NOT NULL state column with bound default retains existing complete source rows. An awaiting row persists only its actual target JSON. Restart preserves both states.

actualActions: Complete point annotation, reopen its draft chip, select Canvas region, wait 600 ms, then normal Done.
Read the newly completed version, wait for its thumbnail, and Send the matching saved capture.
Edit comment text and confirm the original capture/version remain.
Hold a target-save response after service commit, change the target back, then deliver the late response and complete the fresh version.
